text: Six in the morning. The Tallow Bay Lantern goes to press with a fire.
Smoke over the mill. Nobody went to look. The type was set in four minutes.
By noon, the rumour has grown. Three people hurt, says the second edition.
The smoke came from the bakery on Harbour Road, and a new oven on its first morning. Nobody was hurt.
asr: The smoke came from the bakery on Harbor Road, and a new oven on its first morning. Nobody was hurt.

text: So the old type comes out, and the truth goes in.
By evening, the street has bread, and the paper has a correction, set as large as the mistake.
Be quick. Then be right. And print the fix where the mistake stood.
